verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs establish the core primitives (Workflows as ordinary code, Activities, automatic retries, worker/task-queue tuning) that back parallel/fan-out patterns, and a CLI batch-job feature (temporal-docs-26) plus 'why Temporal' messaging about eliminating hand-rolled coordination (temporal-docs-18, temporal-docs-46) support the theme.
